_doc: Info cards the engine unlocks: titles and when each unlocks. 'found' is how the day's journal line records the card; without it the line reads 'Found: <title>.' The signs-* cards are the Signs of Country, counted apart from the collecting loop. The bodies and their sources are in src/ui/copy.ts (CARD_TEXT, CARD_SOURCES), written fresh from the 1813 journals and the sources in SPEC.md.

signs-huts.title: Huts
signs-huts.found: Signs of people: huts near the ridge.

signs-smoke.title: Smoke below the ridge
signs-smoke.found: Signs of people: the fires of about thirty people in the country below.

signs-woodcutter.title: A man cutting wood
signs-woodcutter.found: Signs of people: a man heard cutting wood by the swamp.

signs-camps.title: An old campsite
signs-camps.found: Signs of people: the fires of a camp left the day before.
